quest.title: To the Night, What is the Night's
quest.description: You encounter a strange door out in the wilds of Natlan...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Shattered Night Jade x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}, there's a sealed gate over here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't ask how, but Paimon's got the feeling that the strange things we picked up nearby must have something to do with getting it open.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weird... Just what could be behind this gate?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

choices.text: It could lead to a monster's lair...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... And where there be monsters, there be treasures too, right?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's not a given.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on, stop being such a downer. We'll find out once we get inside!
Hey, you two! Outlanders! And that... scarf-wearing Tepetlisaurus over there!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Arr?
Heh, aren't you the energetic one? Seriously, though, haven't you told them that a seal's a seal because it's meant to seal off forbidden areas?
And you won't find anything in there except for terribly profound curses.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so that means... there's no treasure?
Oh, I'm sure there is. Probably.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Probably?
Yes. But what it is, is something you outlanders shouldn't be poking around, for the "forbidden ground" that lies behind that door is also "holy ground."
Only experienced Couriers who have completed the trials and received approval may enter. Within, it is said, lies a medium by which our ancestors communed with the world of night...
Speaking of which, I wasn't gone that long, was I? And yet here you are, with the three trial completion keystones in tow... Impressive.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh! When it comes to climbing up and down looking for stuff, you won't find many better than us!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!
Even tribal couriers might not match your speed. Well, you're still not permitted to enter these taboo grounds, but... my camp is nearby.
How about I treat you to a quick bite, and then you can enjoy a comfy rest?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrooo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon... Well, Paimon is kinda hungry. Why don't we just take a short little break?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Same old Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Says you... Paimon's still growing, you know!
Pfft... You two sure seem to get along well. Alright, come along now. My camp — and rest — await.
I will prepare some hot food, guests from afar — and should chance allow, we may have much to talk about.

choices.text: Since we've come this far already...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry about it! You can rest, Paimon'll keep watch!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sure you won't just sleep sounder than I will?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously!? Grr... Paimon'll show you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! That's what Paimon's gut is telling her too!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't get too excited now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, right. Let's just go in and find out! First we get this gate open, and then... Hehe. Fee, fie, foo, fum. Treasure, treasure, here we come!

dialogues.text: No need to stand on ceremony. Wanna try my cooking?
If you want to make some yourself, I've got a recipe in the box over there, along with some things I don't use. Feel free to go through 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? You carry recipes on you?
Drew up a bunch of copies myself, as it happens. Might be of use, might not, but it could save a life if you run into someone who needs saving, wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you've sure given this some thought...
After all, you've only yourself to rely on when you're outside the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, we haven't asked your name yet.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: My name? Haha! Call me Legba. And you, friends?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You introduce yourselves to Legba.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: #So, Paimon, {NICKNAME}, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} the little Tepetlisaurus... A marvelous fate it is, that had you meet here in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: #Speaking of which, {NICKNAME}, what were you doing near the tribe's taboo grounds, hmm? Treasure-hunting? Secret-seeking?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's right! A well-protected place like this has gotta be home to treasure, right?

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Whatever the case, don't get any funny ideas about the place, outsiders. I will not permit you to enter.

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: That is where our ancient ancestors re-established contact with the Night, and since that day, more and more tribespeople have been able to enter the Night Kingdom's gates.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Er?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What sorta place is this "Night Kingdom," anyway?

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Haha. Well, I've heard that it's where all people of Natlan go when they leave this world... And only a few ever return.

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: There, they say, the water flows like alluring light. There, they say, monumental obsidian tablets stand. It is no place for you to be curious about, even more so than our taboo grounds...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, so about the thing you mentioned earlier... the one that communicates with the night world...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: A medium, yes. An ancient tool by which our forebears made contact with the Wayob — the envoys of the Night Kingdom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa. An ancient tool...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: ...Perhaps I have said too much. Whatever. Today, a stable connection has been established with the Night Kingdom, and so a medium has long been unnecessary. If you ask me, such methods were quite crude to begin with.

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Still, it is a sacred relic for human tribes.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All right, all right, we get it...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Good. Be right and proper. Do not trespass upon the taboo grounds. That's the way.

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Ha! Haha! Your companion is clever. A clever child indeed.

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: I, too, had many such... brilliant children. But now, I walk alone. Many years it has been since I left the flocks...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Ahem... Ah, night has drawn night sooner than I expected.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *yawn* Honestly, hearing so much stuff she doesn't really understand is making Paimon sleepy...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Ah, look at me, getting all carried away like this. Bring me the occasional person to talk to, and I get all chatty... If you don't mind, would you like to rest here for the night?

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: I can prepare bedding for you. I will be out patrolling at night, anyway, so you need not fear for your safety.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, thanks! That's thoughtful of you!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Lying on a bed of warm grass, you swiftly drift off as the campfire flickers by your side...\nBut you feel as though some faint noise lingers by your ear, preventing you from falling into a deeper slumber.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Until...\nSomething cold and moist makes contact with your cheek, dragging you from the thick, dark night of dreamland...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #You open your eyes to the sight of {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s friendly, familiar face.\nIt seems that he was licking you to wake you up.\nA moment later, you realize that he is trying to show you something — a strange obsidian statue...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Don't you think this thing looks kinda ominous...?

choices.text: You're a reader of omens now, are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's just telling you what she thinks... It looks like bad news!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But wait a sec! This means you ran off while we were sleeping, didn't you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrrooo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not good... Where did you find this thing anyway? ...Was it some sort of super dangerous, super dirty place?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrooo...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? {NICKNAME}! Little Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're still here! What's up?

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: #I hurried here upon hearing {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s cries. What happened?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: This... This is...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Unbelievable. This obsidian statue... is the medium that our ancestors once used to communicate with the Night Kingdom, sealed behind that great gate, deep inside the forbidden grounds...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Did you make the little Tepetlisaurus dig it out for you? You... You stole the tribal relic!? And to think, I even prepared this camp for you, and a place to rest...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It wasn't on purpose!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Mrrooo...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain the situation to Legba...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: So that's what happened. *sigh* To think it slipped my mind how this little one can simply tunnel everywhere... A failure on my part.

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Still, this is a problem... Now, this medium has long been unused, but it is still a sacred relic. And if the Wayob were to be angered, we would be in deep trouble.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do we do, then?

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Whatever the case, I must trouble you all to return the statue to its rightful place.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Yes, that means you too, little troublemaker, hehe! Come, let's go!

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: But just so you are aware — the paths in the ruins are winding and filled with mechanisms, so stay wary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean run!? It's not like we dug it up on purpose!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon! It's not that bad at all. We can just explain!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nyeh... Surely something this ugly couldn't sell for much...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrooo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, where did you get that idea?

choices.text: Neither. Mere curiosity brought us here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. Who wouldn't be curious after seeing a great sealed gate, anyway?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Legba
response.text: Decent people, I'd say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Weren't we in the canyon ruins just now? Where is this...?

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: Come, come. Over here.

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: "Idol"... "Medium"... Return...

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: (The gentle voice drifts in as if from far away, like whispers carried on the wind...)

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: (The cold consciousness constantly calls out to you through... the obsidian statue in your hand...)

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: Return... Return...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: Long has it been since visitors from afar have come. This place is... too big. Too empty.

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: The dark filth enters uninvited, staining even the darkest dreams...

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: Our nation is invaded once more. If the slain are swallowed by the turbulent tides of darkness, the flames of the living, dawn and dusk... All shall be extinguished...

dialogues.speaker: "Projection of an Obsidian Tablet"
dialogues.text: Trust not lightly the so-called vision of the "sacred mountain." Reject... His promise...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: The will of the Wayob made manifest... and you defeated it... You are mightier than I imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Most tribesfolk would have retreated in reverence as soon as they laid eyes on it... For no one knows the reason why such manifestations appear.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: If you are fortunate, they may respond to you, but mostly, they come to "solve" one problem or another.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So even you don't understand the Wayob's intentions?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrrr?

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: As I said before, the Wayob amass the will of departed guardians... They are great yet chaotic and abstruse by comparison, just like their realm, the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Legend has it that in the days after the dragon with blazing wings awoke from within its volcano, wretched humanity could but barely eke out survival from between its great fangs, claws, and the great banner-like span of its wings.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: And in the meantime, the Abyss's influence only grew and grew...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: In that most perilous of times, they say, some tribespeople saw, in a trance, the obsidian branches that remained even in the deepest night.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: And ever since then, more and more people of skill and talent would sense the Night Kingdom out there, beyond mundane sight... and they resisted the Abyss with totems, with the Ley Lines, and with the power of the elements.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: This was the ancient altar where our tribal ancestors would use obsidian to communicate with the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: The Wayob also gradually took shape during that time, totems and consciousnesses created by the congregation of each tribe's living and dead...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's how it is... So that was just a part of the Wayob, then?

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Yes, but a mere embodiment of a single thread of their will. They say that the Wayob possess no true solid shape or form. It might be hard to explain, but, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: That entity will surely reappear should you provoke the Wayob!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh. Let's just focus on putting this statue back on the altar, then!

talks.objective: Find a way to venture deeper into the ruins

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Right. Now it is time to return this to its rightful owner.

talks.objective: Defeat the will of the Wayob
Place the obsidian statue back on the altar

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: You've returned! You gave me quite the fright there, vanishing once you got close to the altar! I thought you'd been abducted by the Wayob...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we got quite the fright ourselves. That place was super freaky. There was even a huge stone tablet that spoke to us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...What's wrong, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Were you worried?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrroo... Mrrroo...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Now, see what I told you? Your friends have returned, no?

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Still... a huge stone tablet, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (You tell Legba what you saw...)

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: *sigh* To defeat a manifestation of the Wayob's will... And from what you said, it sounds like you even entered the Night Kingdom...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: It seems you are no ordinary outlanders... To think that I lived to see one who might return from the Night Kingdom... My life has been worth it after all, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Alright, now that our "little issue" has been resolved, let us return. I must find a way to return the seal back to how it was...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Little issue"!? Didn't we, y'know, do... uh, that, to a manifestation of the will of your tribe's Wayob?

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Eh, it's no biggie. They gather energy from the Ley Lines over time. You needn't fret on their account.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, is it really okay for a tribesperson like you to be that cavalier about your own object of worship?

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: It is fortunate, yes — for you. Were I a stricter adherent, punishment would surely await you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah, no thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: And you, little one. Never dig anything up from around here again!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrah...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Hehe. Either way, let us make haste, before any ancestors decide to protest our actions!

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: Well... according to what's been passed down from our tribe, to enter the altar, we need to... <color=#00E1FFFF>"line up the lights in this place"</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Legba
dialogues.text: I cannot be too sure, but perhaps we must align the height of the lamps controlled by the mechanisms.
